author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a boxy, straight-sided body with a deep narrow bite and a flat horizontal dash for the leaf; redrawn like the reference: rounded body with two top lobes meeting in a pointed dip, a wide concave bite on the right, shallow bottom lobes, and the leaf rising up and to the right above the dip.
omissions: Leaf drawn as one curved stroke rather than an outlined lens (an outlined lens this small reads as an eye/ring).
